name: Therapy Practice
tagline: A warm, human template for therapists — book consultations & sessions from day one.
description: A warm, grounded template for a private therapy & counseling practice — a soft-cream palette, a calm sage primary and a humanist serif, carried by gentle photography. Installs online booking for free consultations and sessions (individual, couples, teen, anxiety, trauma, telehealth), with therapists and private offices as bookable resources for in-person & telehealth counseling. Ships as "Anchor Counseling".
